title: Top K Frequent Elements
tip: Heap or bucket sort. Return any order.
statement: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k` most frequent elements. You may return the answer in any order.
constraints: k is in the range [1, the number of unique elements in nums].
It is guaranteed that the answer is unique.
editorial: Count frequencies. Heap of size k, or bucket sort by frequency.
